message:
docs(cost): plan value rule, export fields and PRD 0030 status

docs/advanced.md describes the plan-value rule for accounts that share a
source, ACCOUNT as the id or provider:name, the rate line per period and
the ignored-values note; docs/tui.md names the English section heading,
Gemini accounts and the plan and rate lines; docs/export-v1.md lists the
price-age, unpriced and settings-notes fields. PRD 0030 gets a
re-validation row (vNEXT), the RF3.1 decision and its open items, and
the control rows of 0030, 0015, 0014, 0018, 0027 and 0046 are updated,
the restore consents routed as open items.

Changelog: skip documentation only
Refs: PRD 0030 RF8
